finding: Custom Elements Manifest (custom-elements.json) does not exist. The Storybook preview.ts imports it via setCustomElementsManifest() which will cause a build failure. CEM-driven autodocs API tables will not render.

finding: No per-component Starlight docs pages exist. Documentation site uses topic-based organization. N/A per deviation rule.
